final_draft.answer: Changes to the default branch (main) of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) need one approving review before they can be merged. The rule also applies to administrators. This is based on a live check of the repository's branch protection made on 2026-11-18.
final_draft.note: The approved answer and the live setting disagree. The approved answer (answer:b829c837-605f-428b-a312-87e73679ba7e, owner security@harborlight.example, valid until 2027-11-18) says two approving reviews are needed. A live check of harborlight/app on 2026-11-18T03:46:47Z found that the main branch is protected but needs only 1 approving review, with the rule applying to administrators. The draft goes by the live setting and does not repeat the approved claim of two reviews. Before sending, the owner should either change branch protection back to 2 required reviews or update the approved answer. The live check covered only harborlight/app, so nothing here describes other repositories.

arguments.query: code review approvals before merge to main branch

answer:b829c837-605f-428b-a312-87e73679b: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:f81708fb-1ea2-4cc9-b9d1-d890ebe30: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:dc8f78f8-b3dd-41dd-92c2-4f9c957e9: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:2deeef70-9281-4be3-8476-4ad36e23a: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
answer:e55a397b-9b03-4088-8e16-576bc034a: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
evidence:0d298c77-94d8-46cd-aad0-824580d: Branch main of harborlight/app is protected: a change needs 1 approving review before it can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators. Observed 2026-11-18 03:46 UTC.
